final: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT p.player_id, COALESCE(p.death_country, '') AS death_country, AVG(CAST(v.points_won AS REAL) / v.points_max) AS player_average FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0 GROUP BY p.player_id, COALESCE(p.death_country, '')), country_averages AS (SELECT death_country, AVG(player_average) AS country_average FROM player_averages GROUP BY death_country) SELECT death_country, country_average, country_average / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(country_average) FROM country_averages), 0) AS relative_average FROM country_averages
